description: PART B — Replace the coach's unrigged coach.obj with the RIGGED astronaut GLB (Ed Stronaut) and drive believable trainer limb motion. NOTE: the LIVE user message overrides the original Saitama choice — use ed-stronaut-astronaut-extraordinaire.zip (astronaut), NOT Saitama. Rewrite components/coach/CoachScene.tsx to load public/models/characters/astronaut/astronaut.glb (useGLTF/GLTFLoader; self-contained, no loose-texture wiring), and implement procedural bone gesturing gated to the `speaking` window (the astronaut has 52 joints but 0 baked clips). Keep engine routing (focus/focusNonce), the clickable kettlebell prop, and canvas aria (describe an astronaut trainer). Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: In components/coach/CoachScene.tsx, replace the OBJLoader+MTLLoader coach.obj load with the astronaut GLB. Load via useGLTF(asset('/models/characters/astronaut/astronaut.glb')) (or GLTFLoader through useLoader). It is self-contained with 14 embedded textures — do NOT hand-wire the loose extracted textures. Clone with SkeletonUtils.clone so the skinned meshes rebind (a plain clone collapses skinned meshes). Ensure color/diffuse maps are sRGB; keep ACESFilmic and the near-neutral rig so there is no skin blow-out (WS2) — verify on the astronaut.

MEASURE bounds at runtime (probe confirmed: rigged, 52 joints, 0 animations, humanoid bone names present). Scale + recenter with Box3 for a front-facing head-and-torso framing consistent with the chef's cozy shot (reuse AIM_HEIGHT/AIM_MODEL_FRACTION/CAMERA_DISTANCE approach). Record measured bounds and chosen framing constants.

Implement procedural bone gesturing modeled on ChefScene's ARM_BONES: resolve bones BY NAME on the cloned model in an effect and capture each bone's rest rotation once. CONFIRMED bone names in this GLB: 'RightArm','RightForeArm','RightHand','LeftArm','LeftForeArm','LeftHand','Spine','Spine1','Spine2','Neck','Head','Hips' (NO mixamorig prefix). Any missing bone is skipped gracefully with a console.warn (do NOT throw). If the expected bones do NOT resolve at runtime, STOP and surface it rather than guessing.

In useFrame, ease a single 0..1 gesture amount toward 1 while `speaking` and 0 otherwise (framerate-independent), multiply small per-bone time-based sin offsets (differing freq/phase per bone and per side) added ON TOP of each captured rest rotation so the astronaut gestures with its arms/spine/head while the reply plays and eases back to rest when silent. Bound amplitudes so limbs read clearly but never clip through the body. Gate to reducedMotion (target 0 -> exact rest pose). Optionally layer a very subtle idle sway. This delivers REAL limb motion (the old OBJ and the Saitama option could not).

Keep the CameraRig (focus/focusNonce engine-driven nudge), the clickable KettlebellProp -> onKettlebellClick (routes through CoachChatbot's existing send()), FloorShimmer/GroundBackdrop/ContactShadows, and all reducedMotion gating. Preserve DEFAULT_QUALITY/qualitySettings usage (WS2). Dispose mixer(if any)/uncached resources on unmount.

Update the Canvas aria-label (role='img' stays) to describe an animated 3D astronaut gym coach that gestures while giving workout advice. Update the CoachScene top-of-file comment (no longer an unrigged OBJ; now a rigged GLB with procedural bone gesturing) and the 'Coach Fabric' framing note. Update coach route copy if it names an OBJ/unrigged coach.

Grep for coach.obj / coach.mtl references; remove the now-unused public/models/characters/coach/* (coach.obj, coach.mtl, the two out.png textures) only if nothing else references them at runtime. Note byte impact.
Verify lint + build, then commit on the branch (do NOT push).
acceptance_criteria: components/coach/CoachScene.tsx renders the astronaut GLB (self-contained, SkeletonUtils.clone), NOT coach.obj and NOT Saitama.
Arm/spine/head bones resolve by name and the astronaut visibly gestures with its limbs while `speaking`, easing back to rest when silent; frozen under reducedMotion.
The astronaut is framed front-facing head-and-torso, consistent with the chef; no skin blow-out under ACESFilmic (WS2).
Engine routing (focus/focusNonce) and the clickable kettlebell -> engine send() are unchanged; canvas keeps role='img' with an astronaut-trainer aria-label.
npm run lint (font warning only) and npm run build (static export) both pass.
verification: export PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH && npm run lint && npm run build
node scripts/measure-load.mjs --dir out --route /projects/coach-trainer/ --label after-coach --out docs/fixes  (astronaut framed, canvas reached)
node scripts/measure-viewports.mjs --route /projects/coach-trainer/ --label after-coach --out docs/fixes  (390 + 1280, no horizontal scroll)
findings:
DONE. Rewrote components/coach/CoachScene.tsx to load the RIGGED astronaut GLB (public/models/characters/astronaut/astronaut.glb, Ed Stronaut) via useLoader(GLTFLoader) + SkeletonUtils.clone, replacing the unrigged coach.obj (and NOT Saitama, per the live user override).

RIG (re-verified at build time by parsing the GLB JSON chunk with _assetwork/probe-glb.mjs): self-contained, 14 embedded images (GLTFLoader decodes them automatically — no loose-texture wiring), 4 meshes (avaturn_body/hair_0/shoes_0/look_0), 1 skin, CONFIRMED 52 joints across 57 nodes, 0 baked animation clips. Bone names carry NO mixamorig prefix: Hips, Spine, Spine1, Spine2, Neck, Head, Left/Right Shoulder/Arm/ForeArm/Hand (+finger bones), Left/Right UpLeg/Leg/Foot/ToeBase, plus an Armature. Because it ships a skeleton but ZERO clips, real limb motion is PROCEDURAL (chosen lower-risk path over FBX retargeting, whose map expects mixamorig-prefixed names this rig lacks).

HOW LIMB MOTION IS DRIVEN: modeled on ChefScene's ARM_BONES. GESTURE_BONES map resolves RightArm/RightForeArm/RightHand, LeftArm/LeftForeArm/LeftHand, Spine1(spine), Spine2(chest), Neck, Head BY NAME on the cloned model in a useEffect; each bone's rest rotation is captured once as a fresh Euler (missing bones console.warn + skip, never throw). In useFrame a single smoothed 0..1 gesture amount eases toward 1 while `speaking` and 0 when silent (framerate-independent, k=1-exp(-delta*6)); it multiplies bounded per-bone time-based sin offsets (differing freq/phase per bone and per side) ADDED ON TOP of each captured rest rotation. Amplitudes: arms ~0.26 rad, forearm raise ~0.50 rad, hands ~0.30 rad, spine/chest/neck/head under ~0.07 rad — clearly readable yet bounded so limbs never clip the torso/head within the fixed head-and-torso framing. A tiny always-on idle sway (~0.010-0.012 rad on spine/chest/neck/head) keeps the figure alive when silent. reducedMotion drives the gesture target AND idle to 0 => exact rest pose held.

FRAMING: measured bounds at runtime with Box3 (astronaut stands upright, Y tallest). Scale off the TALLEST bound to MODEL_TARGET_HEIGHT=1.7, then recenter off a fresh Box3 of the scaled model so a point AIM_MODEL_FRACTION=0.82 up its height sits at AIM_HEIGHT=1.3, camera at [0,1.3,2.4] fov 34 (CAMERA_DISTANCE=2.4). after-coach.png confirms a front-facing head-and-torso shot; NASA suit reads its true white/blue colors with NO blow-out under the unchanged ACESFilmic + near-neutral light rig (WS2) — tone mapping untouched.

COLOR: GLTFLoader already assigns correct color spaces; I only make it explicit (map + emissiveMap -> SRGBColorSpace; data maps stay linear) and do NOT swap the GLB's PBR materials. DISPOSAL: geometries/materials/embedded textures are owned by the loader cache and shared by SkeletonUtils.clone, so they are deliberately NOT disposed here (disposing would corrupt strict-mode remounts); only bone refs are dropped on unmount.

PRESERVED: CameraRig (focus/focusNonce engine nudge), clickable KettlebellProp -> onKettlebellClick (CoachChatbot routes it through its existing send('Suggest a workout')), FloorShimmer/GroundBackdrop/ContactShadows, all reducedMotion gates, DEFAULT_QUALITY/qualitySettings, SceneLoader Suspense, Canvas role='img'. Updated the Canvas aria-label to 'Animated 3D astronaut gym coach that gestures with its arms while giving workout advice', the top-of-file comment, and README coach paragraph (unrigged OBJ -> rigged GLB + procedural gesturing). CoachChatbot.tsx unchanged (WS3). getLoudness is still forwarded (accepted in props) but the bone gesturing does not use loudness — jaw-style amplitude is not applicable to a full-body gesture.

CLEANUP: removed public/models/characters/coach/* (coach.obj 526458 + 0000026121C8D638out.png 82886 + 0000026121C8EDF8out.png 1317 + coach.mtl 426) via git rm — freed 611189 bytes (~597 KB). No runtime code references them after the rewrite; only frozen prior-run evidence JSONs under docs/{perf,motion,visual} mention them and were left untouched. (assets-src/models/characters/coach/ still exists but is git-ignored and only used by the manual compressor.)

VERIFY: npm run lint = 0 errors, 1 expected @next/next/no-page-custom-font warning. npm run build = static export OK, all 6 routes prerender (before AND after the coach/* removal). Evidence to docs/fixes: measure-load (cold load hasCanvas=true, ready=true, .glb 3.913 MB reached; the 2 reported errors are the harness's own /frankfabric/ base-path document/favicon 404s, unrelated to the scene — same artifact in prior runs) and measure-viewports (390x844 and 1280x900 both noHorizontalScroll=true, hasCanvas=true). Gesture is speaking-gated so the headless harness shows the rest/T-pose; the gesturing is verified by the bone-write logic + rest capture (all 10 bones resolve by name — confirmed present in the probe).

STEERING: both live steer messages handled — steer #1 (use ed-stronaut astronaut as coach) is exactly what this feature implements; steer #2 ('what is pending?') answered in the response summary.
